title: Goldman Sachs estimates each week of a diesel export ban would cut US 🇺🇸 retail diesel prices by about 25 cents a gallon from the current $6.50, but warned a longer ban would push gasoline prices higher once storage fills. Energy Sec. Wright said last week a ban wouldn't work.
